facts.text: Knowledge records have status `candidate` or `verified`, and the store rejects a `verified` record that has no evidence.
The shared memory root is `sharedMemoryRoot()`, which returns `PI_SWARM_MEMORY_DIR` if set, otherwise `~/.swarm/memory`.
`project_context` is a read-only hybrid search over repo markdown and `.ts`/`.mjs` source, including `.pi/`. It calls Agent-MCP `ask_project_rag` on spark, not a local index.

The memory store can add dense ranking: with `PI_SWARM_MEMORY_EMBED_URL` set, vectors are cached per record revision in `embeddings.jsonl` and fused by RRF (k=60). Failure degrades to BM25. This contradicts the claim that memory records reach no embedding index.
`tools/e2e/taskmanage-answer-memory.mjs` checks a verified TaskManage answer end to end. Recall uses `recallKnowledge` from `.pi/lib/context/knowledge-recall.ts`, which bootstrap calls.

Path-only answers stay `candidate` with the `evidence-unanchored` tag and are not recalled. Verified records drop out as stale when a cited span is edited, but editing an uncited line keeps them verified.
